Which model, and which firmware if you know it.

Run this with the headphones connected to your Mac and paste the whole output:

```sh
swift run xmprobe --explore
```

It reads only. If something in the app does not work on your model, say what you pressed and what
the headphones did, and paste the output from that run too.
